name: device-login-after-connected

graded_by.test: core/internal/ws/device_login_test.go — TestACancelBeforeOpensLastCheckWithdrawsAndALostSocketLeavesADetachedSession: a cancel before the last check leaves no session, a cancel after it is ignored, a lost socket leaves a detached owned session

description: Two cancel points, read exactly (OQ4 (c)). A `device_login_cancel` is honoured when the device login takes `connected` and once more inside `open`, just before the durable record: `open` then withdraws the session the way it withdraws a failed one, leaving nothing, and the result is `cancelled` with no audit event, since the device accepted and no session exists. A cancel read after that is ignored, as a frame after the result is, and the session opens. A lost socket never withdraws: after the core took `connected` the open goes on and the session lives on detached, owned and listed, as a 201 nobody read does.
corpus: device-login step 20, how a device login ends
